summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing it closed the acquisition of the entire 23.03% equity stake in Dona Francisca Energética S.A. (DFESA) held by Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL). The transaction closed at a total value of R$150 million (approximately BRL), with a total cash disbursement of R$150,719,205.75 including proportional consolidated cash. It was fully paid in cash from own resources and received Brazilian antitrust approval. This is a completed acquisition of a minority stake aligned with Gerdau's decarbonization and renewable energy self-production strategy. The price per share was not explicitly stated. The acquisition is now concluded, so no further regulatory steps remain; watch for ongoing integration and financial impact.
